# dsh-why

Diagnose DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin load failures. `npx dsh-why` reads your install (what you have, what crashes the loader, why, and how to fix it); the web page at https://dsh-why.com diagnoses a pasted red-screen error without any install.

## Data (stable URLs, crawlable)

- https://dsh-insights.com/data/shell-seeds.json — per-shell client module tables (dsh-why consumes)
- https://dsh-insights.com/data/shell-rows.json — per-shell client graph rows
- https://dsh-insights.com/data/fixes.json — known-fix case base (dsh-why consumes)
- https://dsh-insights.com/data/compat-observed.json — observed-compat matrix

## Pages

- https://dsh-why.com/ — paste an error, get the diagnosis (browser-side, nothing uploaded)
- https://github.com/ice5kysl/dsh-why — source, README with the error-string reference
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-why — the CLI package

## The CLI

- `npx dsh-why` — diagnose the current environment
- `npx dsh-why --json` — machine-readable (CI / an LLM)
- `npx dsh-why --offline` — bundled rule base only
- `npx dsh-why --error "…"` — diagnose a pasted error (or pipe it via stdin)
